businessModel: Free; funnel to Naver search, services and Naver ads; AI features tied to Naver CLOVA/HyperCLOVA ecosystem
updateCadence: Desktop roughly every 1-2 months tracking Chromium; Android point releases frequent
summary: Naver Whale is Naver's Chromium-based browser, popular in South Korea (about 8% share per MoneyToday). It bundles a sidebar, Papago translation, Whale Space multitasking and, since Oct 2026, an AI Chat assistant.
bestFor: Korean-language users and Naver account holders
People who like a built-in sidebar of web apps
notFor: People who dislike Naver as default search
Users who need Linux-first support or an English-only UX

pros.title: Sidebar and Whale Space
pros.detail: Sidebar mini-apps, scrapbook and multitasking views are core to the design.

pros.title: Papago translation
pros.detail: Naver Papago handles page translation with strong Korean quality.

pros.title: AI Chat in sidebar
pros.detail: AI Chat (launched 2026-10-01) summarises pages, organises tabs and edits Naver Calendar events with confirmation.

pros.title: Chrome Web Store compatible
pros.detail: Chromium base lets users add Chrome extensions alongside the Whale Store.

pros.title: Multi-platform
pros.detail: Windows, macOS, Linux (per Wikipedia), Android and iOS.

cons.title: Naver-centric
cons.detail: Defaults and best features assume a Naver account.

cons.title: Telemetry and jurisdiction
cons.detail: Closed-source with Naver data collection under Korean law.

cons.title: Chromium lag
cons.detail: Changelog showed Chromium 144 in Jan 2026-era builds, behind Chrome.

cons.title: Limited global presence
cons.detail: Support and UI polish are Korea-first.
